name: invoice-ai-sdk
description: Official Invoice-AI SDKs (TypeScript, Python) and CLI.

scripts.sdk:gen: pnpm --filter @horizonpay/invoice-ai run gen:schema && tsx scripts/sdk-gen/ts.ts && tsx scripts/sdk-gen/python.ts
scripts.cli:docs: pnpm --filter @horizonpay/invoice-ai build && pnpm --filter @horizonpay/invoice-ai-cli build && pnpm --filter @horizonpay/invoice-ai-cli run docs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/release/sync-versions.mjs && node scripts/ci/check-versions.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm build && bash scripts/ci/pack-smoke.sh node && changeset publish
